turns.query: At Causeway Bay station (station_id 17) over June 2025, find the single hour timestamp with the highest NO2. Then compute the mean traffic speed (from the hourly road-segment traffic records) at that same timestamp across the road segments whose geometry lies within 300 metres of the station (non-NULL speed). Return that peak NO2 value (1 dp) and the mean speed (2 dp).
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Entity resolution (explicit id supplied; use as-is, no name re-resolution)
station_id_causeway_bay = 17
june_2025_start_ts = "2025-06-01 00:00:00"
june_2025_end_ts = "2025-07-01 00:00:00"
traffic_segment_radius_m = 300.0
print(f"RESOLVED: Causeway Bay station_id = {station_id_causeway_bay}")

# Domain knowledge needed for interpretation
no2_unit_note = "NO2 concentrations are recorded in micrograms per cubic metre (µg/m3)."
time_window_note = "June 2025 means [2025-06-01 00:00:00, 2025-07-01 00:00:00), using hourly records."
traffic_speed_unit_note = "Road-segment speed is the recorded hourly traffic speed; use database-native speed units."
spatial_distance_note = "Road segments within 300 m are identified by PostGIS geodesic distance between station geography and segment geometry."
print("DOMAIN_NOTE: " + no2_unit_note)
print("DOMAIN_NOTE: " + time_window_note)
print("DOMAIN_NOTE: " + traffic_speed_unit_note)
print("DOMAIN_NOTE: " + spatial_distance_note)

# Fetch station geometry
cwb_station_geometry_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT id AS station_id, name_en, ST_AsText(coordinate::geometry) AS station_wkt
    FROM air_quality_station
    WHERE id = :station_id
"""), engine, params={"station_id": station_id_causeway_bay})
print(f"cwb_station_geometry_df rows = {len(cwb_station_geometry_df)}")
if cwb_station_geometry_df.empty:
    print(f"UNRESOLVED: station_id {station_id_causeway_bay} has no station record")
else:
    print(f"Station geometry available rows = {len(cwb_station_geometry_df)}")

# Fetch June 2025 hourly NO2 observations
cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT station_id, datetime, no2
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality
    WHERE station_id = :station_id
      AND datetime >= :start_ts
      AND datetime < :end_ts
      AND no2 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY datetime
"""), engine, params={
    "station_id": station_id_causeway_bay,
    "start_ts": june_2025_start_ts,
    "end_ts": june_2025_end_ts
})
print(f"cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df rows = {len(cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df)}")
if cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df.empty:
    # Re-check whether any hourly AQ records exist for this id/time window before downstream use
    cwb_june2025_aq_recheck_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
        SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_hourly_records,
               COUNT(no2)::int AS nonnull_no2_records,
               MIN(datetime) AS first_datetime,
               MAX(datetime) AS last_datetime
        FROM hourly_station_air_quality
        WHERE station_id = :station_id
          AND datetime >= :start_ts
          AND datetime < :end_ts
    """), engine, params={
        "station_id": station_id_causeway_bay,
        "start_ts": june_2025_start_ts,
        "end_ts": june_2025_end_ts
    })
    print("NO2 empty recheck: " + cwb_june2025_aq_recheck_df.to_string(index=False))
else:
    cwb_june2025_no2_summary_df = cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df["no2"].agg(["count", "min", "max", "mean"]).to_frame().T
    print("cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df summary: " + cwb_june2025_no2_summary_df.round(3).to_string(index=False))

# Large-table discipline: count June 2025 non-null speed traffic records within 300m before fetching
cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_count_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS traffic_record_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.road_segment_id)::int AS segment_count,
           MIN(t.datetime) AS first_datetime,
           MAX(t.datetime) AS last_datetime
    FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic t
    JOIN road_segment rs ON rs.id = t.road_segment_id
    JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON aqs.id = :station_id
    WHERE t.datetime >= :start_ts
      AND t.datetime < :end_ts
      AND t.speed IS NOT NULL
      AND ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, aqs.coordinate, :radius_m)
"""), engine, params={
    "station_id": station_id_causeway_bay,
    "start_ts": june_2025_start_ts,
    "end_ts": june_2025_end_ts,
    "radius_m": traffic_segment_radius_m
})
print("cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_count_df: " + cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_count_df.to_string(index=False))

# Fetch hourly road-segment traffic records with geometries for June 2025 within 300m and non-NULL speeds
cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT t.road_segment_id,
           t.datetime,
           t.speed,
           t.congestion_status,
           t.congestion_index,
           rs.length,
           rs.road_level,
           ST_Distance(rs.geometry::geography, aqs.coordinate) AS distance_to_station_m,
           ST_AsText(rs.geometry) AS road_segment_wkt
    FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic t
    JOIN road_segment rs ON rs.id = t.road_segment_id
    JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON aqs.id = :station_id
    WHERE t.datetime >= :start_ts
      AND t.datetime < :end_ts
      AND t.speed IS NOT NULL
      AND ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, aqs.coordinate, :radius_m)
    ORDER BY t.datetime, t.road_segment_id
"""), engine, params={
    "station_id": station_id_causeway_bay,
    "start_ts": june_2025_start_ts,
    "end_ts": june_2025_end_ts,
    "radius_m": traffic_segment_radius_m
})
print(f"cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df rows = {len(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df)}")
if cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df.empty:
    cwb_nearby_segment_recheck_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
        SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS nearby_segment_count
        FROM road_segment rs
        JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON aqs.id = :station_id

    """), engine, params={"station_id": station_id_causeway_bay, "radius_m": traffic_segment_radius_m})
    print("Traffic empty recheck: " + cwb_nearby_segment_recheck_df.to_string(index=False))
else:
    cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{
        "record_count": int(len(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df)),
        "segment_count": int(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df["road_segment_id"].nunique()),
        "speed_min": float(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df["speed"].min()),
        "speed_max": float(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df["speed"].max()),
        "speed_mean": float(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df["speed"].mean()),
        "distance_min_m": float(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df["distance_to_station_m"].min()),
        "distance_max_m": float(cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df["distance_to_station_m"].max())
    }])
    print("cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_with_geometry_df summary: " + cwb_june2025_nearby_traffic_summary_df.round(3).to_string(index=False))

# Stage an auxiliary peak timestamp/value for synthesis use without assigning required output variables
if not cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df.empty:
    cwb_june2025_no2_peak_context_df = cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df.loc[
        cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df["no2"].eq(cwb_june2025_no2_observations_df["no2"].max()),
        ["station_id", "datetime", "no2"]
    ].sort_values("datetime").reset_index(drop=True)
    print(f"cwb_june2025_no2_peak_context_df rows = {len(cwb_june2025_no2_peak_context_df)}")
    print("cwb_june2025_no2_peak_context_df summary: " + cwb_june2025_no2_peak_context_df.agg({"no2": ["count", "min", "max"]}).T.to_string())

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Use already staged authoritative ids/timestamps/radius; do not assign required output variables.
spatial_cwb_peak_speed_query_status = "not_run"

# First check spatially/time-filtered row counts before aggregating.
spatial_cwb_peak_speed_count_df = pd.read_sql(
    text("""
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS traffic_rows,
            COUNT(hrt.speed) AS non_null_speed_rows,
            COUNT(DISTINCT rs.id) AS distinct_segments
        FROM air_quality_station aqs
        JOIN road_segment rs
          ON ST_DWithin(aqs.coordinate, rs.geometry::geography, :radius_m)
        LEFT JOIN hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
          ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
         AND hrt.datetime = :peak_ts
        WHERE aqs.id = :station_id
    """),
    engine,
    params={
        "station_id": int(station_id_causeway_bay),
        "radius_m": float(traffic_segment_radius_m),
        "peak_ts": cwb_june2025_peak_no2_datetime_for_matching
    }
)

spatial_cwb_peak_speed_traffic_rows = int(spatial_cwb_peak_speed_count_df.loc[0, "traffic_rows"])
spatial_cwb_peak_speed_non_null_rows = int(spatial_cwb_peak_speed_count_df.loc[0, "non_null_speed_rows"])
spatial_cwb_peak_speed_distinct_segments = int(spatial_cwb_peak_speed_count_df.loc[0, "distinct_segments"])

if spatial_cwb_peak_speed_traffic_rows == 0:
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_query_status = "empty_spatial_filter_no_segments_within_radius"
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_unrounded = None
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_rounded_2dp = None
elif spatial_cwb_peak_speed_non_null_rows == 0:
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_query_status = "segments_found_but_no_non_null_speeds_at_peak_timestamp"
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_unrounded = None

else:
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_agg_df = pd.read_sql(
        text("""
            SELECT
                AVG(hrt.speed)::double precision AS mean_speed,
                MIN(hrt.speed)::double precision AS min_speed,

            FROM air_quality_station aqs
            JOIN road_segment rs
              ON ST_DWithin(aqs.coordinate, rs.geometry::geography, :radius_m)
            JOIN hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
              ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
             AND hrt.datetime = :peak_ts
            WHERE aqs.id = :station_id
              AND hrt.speed IS NOT NULL
        """),
        engine,
        params={
            "station_id": int(station_id_causeway_bay),
            "radius_m": float(traffic_segment_radius_m),
            "peak_ts": cwb_june2025_peak_no2_datetime_for_matching
        }
    )
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_unrounded = float(spatial_cwb_peak_speed_agg_df.loc[0, "mean_speed"])
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_rounded_2dp = round(spatial_cwb_peak_speed_unrounded, 2)
    spatial_cwb_peak_speed_min = float(spatial_cwb_peak_speed_agg_df.loc[0, "min_speed"])

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

old_cwb_peak_no2 = cwb_peak_no2 if 'cwb_peak_no2' in globals() else None
old_cwb_peak_speed = cwb_peak_speed if 'cwb_peak_speed' in globals() else None

q = text("""
WITH station AS (
  SELECT id, coordinate
  FROM air_quality_station
  WHERE id = 17 AND name_en = 'Causeway Bay'
),
peak AS (
  SELECT datetime, no2
  FROM hourly_station_air_quality
  WHERE station_id = 17
    AND datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
    AND datetime <  TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND no2 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY no2 DESC, datetime ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
ties AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS tie_count
  FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
  CROSS JOIN peak p
  WHERE h.station_id = 17
    AND h.datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
    AND h.datetime <  TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND h.no2 = p.no2
),
obs AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS obs_count, MAX(no2) AS max_no2
  FROM hourly_station_air_quality
  WHERE station_id = 17
    AND datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
    AND datetime <  TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND no2 IS NOT NULL
),
near_segments AS (
  SELECT rs.id
  FROM road_segment rs
  CROSS JOIN station s
  WHERE ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, s.coordinate, 300)
),
traffic AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS traffic_rows,
         COUNT(h.speed) AS non_null_speed_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT h.road_segment_id) FILTER (WHERE h.speed IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_segments_with_speed,
         AVG(h.speed::double precision) FILTER (WHERE h.speed IS NOT NULL) AS mean_speed,
         MIN(h.speed) FILTER (WHERE h.speed IS NOT NULL) AS min_speed,
         MAX(h.speed) FILTER (WHERE h.speed IS NOT NULL) AS max_speed
  FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic h
  JOIN near_segments ns ON ns.id = h.road_segment_id
  CROSS JOIN peak p
  WHERE h.datetime = p.datetime
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station) AS station_match_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM near_segments) AS nearby_segment_count,
  p.datetime AS peak_datetime,
  p.no2 AS peak_no2_unrounded,
  obs.obs_count,
  obs.max_no2,
  ties.tie_count,
  traffic.traffic_rows,
  traffic.non_null_speed_rows,
  traffic.distinct_segments_with_speed,
  traffic.mean_speed AS mean_speed_unrounded,
  traffic.min_speed,
  traffic.max_speed
FROM peak p
CROSS JOIN obs
CROSS JOIN ties
CROSS JOIN traffic;
""")
res = pd.read_sql(q, engine)

if res.empty:
    raise ValueError("Independent verification returned no peak NO2 record for Causeway Bay station_id 17 in June 2025.")

row = res.iloc[0]
ind_cwb_peak_no2 = round(float(row["peak_no2_unrounded"]), 1)
ind_cwb_peak_speed = round(float(row["mean_speed_unrounded"]), 2)

cwb_peak_no2 = ind_cwb_peak_no2
cwb_peak_speed = ind_cwb_peak_speed

print("Independent checks: station_match_count=%s | obs_count=%s | peak_datetime=%s | tie_count=%s | nearby_segment_count=%s | traffic_rows=%s | non_null_speed_rows=%s | distinct_segments_with_speed=%s | speed_range=[%s,%s]" % (
    int(row["station_match_count"]), int(row["obs_count"]), row["peak_datetime"], int(row["tie_count"]),
    int(row["nearby_segment_count"]), int(row["traffic_rows"]), int(row["non_null_speed_rows"]),
    int(row["distinct_segments_with_speed"]), row["min_speed"], row["max_speed"]
))
print(f"VERIFY cwb_peak_no2: stored={old_cwb_peak_no2} | independent={ind_cwb_peak_no2} | final={cwb_peak_no2}")
print(f"VERIFY cwb_peak_speed: stored={old_cwb_peak_speed} | independent={ind_cwb_peak_speed} | final={cwb_peak_speed}")
print(f"cwb_peak_no2={cwb_peak_no2}")
print(f"cwb_peak_speed={cwb_peak_speed}")
